verdict.rationale: Sentry documents running all of Sentry on your own server for free, and one long-term user reports self-hosted Sentry running rock-solid in production. However, Sentry describes it as a minimal setup for simple use cases with no guarantees or dedicated support, and community reports describe ballooning containers and memory plus heavy maintenance effort across releases. Missing for 10: documented self-hosted architecture, a documented upgrade path, vendor-supported production-grade deployment guidance, and evidence that self-hosted releases keep parity with SaaS.
